review.use_summary: Downloaded JASPAR 2024 CORE vertebrate nonredundant frequency matrices in MEME format. Chose one representative per TF by assay provenance, then original nsites and motif length.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is use of a motif file format and supplied models, not a MEME discovery run. The separately reviewed FIMO scan and custom allele-score completion are distinct operations. Do not infer a MEME executable edition or discovery settings.

review.use_summary: Used a local Linux MEME-ChIP workflow on central 200-bp ChIP-seq peak sequences, with 200-bp background regions 1 kb upstream, blacklist filtering, a Markov model and JASPAR motifs. MEME and DREME discovered motifs, CentriMo checked central enrichment, and Tomtom compared known motifs. Reused discovered PWMs in separate nucleosome scans and positional summaries.
review.implementation_scope_note: The suite edition is unstated. Preserve the reported pipeline options, including -nmeme 600, -meme-mod zoops, widths 6–18, -meme-maxsize 50000000, -dreme-e 0.00001 and -dreme-m 20. These are historical pipeline tokens, not a current-version command inferred by translation. seqPattern/Biostrings scanning, strand-specific counts and downstream smoothing remain separate.

review.use_summary: Named MEME Suite as the provider of Tomtom for motif-similarity comparisons. Hierarchically clustered similarities and summarized TF-class motif pairs passing q < 0.1.
review.implementation_scope_note: This paragraph does not document a MEME de novo discovery run. Tomtom, ggseqlogo, clustering and class-pair summaries remain distinct. The suite edition and the exact comparison/correction and pair-counting families are unstated.

review.use_summary: Used MEME 4.9.1 to examine known and newly discovered binding motifs in tag-enriched ChIP-seq sequences following Bowtie2 alignment and MACS2 peak selection.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact MEME command, input/background population, alphabet, widths and occurrence model are unstated. The description of known motifs does not establish a separate scanning program or matching threshold. DiffBind and tag-density visualization are separate analyses; a newer MEME build does not establish 4.9.1 parity.

review.use_summary: Attributed transcription-factor motif quantification in lost ARID1A-bound regions to FIMO from MEME Suite. The resulting motif occurrences informed the reported ZIC-family enhancer interpretation.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is FIMO occurrence scanning, not an additional MEME discovery run. The separate HOMER analysis used shuffled sequences and E < 0.001; neither that background construction nor the E cutoff is assigned to FIMO. Suite edition and FIMO P/q, strand and pseudocount settings are unstated.

review.use_summary: Used FIMO from MEME Suite 5.5.4 to scan supplied sequences with JASPAR/HOCOMOCO PWMs and retain individual motif matches at P < 0.001 in the TMEM216 promoter-variant analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: No MEME discovery run is described. This is an occurrence P-value cutoff, not a stated q cutoff. Exact sequence/background/strand/pseudocount choices and the independent promoter and experimental interpretation remain separate.

review.use_summary: Used STREME from MEME Suite 5.5.4 to detect H3-associated k-mers in an intronic MUC5AC VNTR analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The named program is STREME, not MEME EM discovery or HyPhy MEME. H3 does not establish a motif width of three. Width/background/control/objective settings are unstated. The listed repeat-finder parameters belong to tandem repeats finder, not STREME.

review.use_summary: Ran meme-chip on central 200-bp ChIP-seq sequences with upstream background regions, a Markov model and JASPAR. Reported -nmeme 600, -meme-mod zoops, -meme-minw 6, -meme-maxw 18, -meme-maxsize 50000000, -dreme-e 0.00001 and -dreme-m 20. Reused the discovered PWM for nucleosome motif scans.
review.implementation_scope_note: The edition, Markov order and complete command are unstated. Historical options remain verbatim and are not silently replaced with newer tokens or STREME. This combined workflow requires its actual MEME/DREME/CentriMo/Tomtom stages; running MEME alone does not reproduce it. seqPattern scanning and smoothing remain downstream.

review.use_summary: Discovered short motifs with DREME inside the reported MEME-ChIP workflow, using pipeline options -dreme-e 0.00001 and -dreme-m 20, before positional enrichment and motif comparison.
review.implementation_scope_note: The edition, complete standalone command and control/background handling are unstated. The E-value setting is not a FIMO P/q threshold. DREME is a separate program; substituting STREME or MEME is not historical pipeline reproduction.

review.use_summary: Used CentriMo after MEME/DREME discovery to check whether the enriched motifs were centrally enriched relative to the described background sequences.
review.implementation_scope_note: Edition, score and region search settings, exact significance threshold and test/correction families are unstated. Central enrichment is separate from de novo discovery, occurrence scanning, Tomtom comparison and later nucleosome counts.

review.use_summary: Compared motifs discovered by MEME/DREME to canonical JASPAR motifs with Tomtom in a MEME-ChIP analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: Edition, distance, background/pseudocount, overlap/strand settings and significance threshold/family are unstated. The pipeline discovery width and DREME E cutoff are not Tomtom settings; similarity is not proof of TF occupancy.

review.use_summary: Ran HyPhy BUSTED with the paper’s stated default settings on back-translated codon alignments and previously reconstructed FastTree2 trees. Retrieved the reported full-codon-model dN/dS summary and discarded gene families with values above 0.5.
review.implementation_scope_note: The HyPhy edition and exact dN/dS field or rate-class aggregation are unstated. Preserve the reported greater-than-0.5 exclusion rather than replacing it with a positive-selection P-value rule. BUSTED gene-wide testing, tree construction and the retrieved rate summary are distinct; this is unrelated to MEME Suite motifs.

review.use_summary: Used aBSREL, reported as 2.5.48, on 15,734 filtered gene alignments and pruned/foreground-labeled mammal trees with --code Universal --branches Foreground. Separately ran BUSTED-MH on multiple orthologue cohorts and HyPhy MEME with --resample 100 to identify diversifying-selection codons in CD45.
review.implementation_scope_note: The aBSREL paragraph states an FDR-corrected P ≤ 0.05 rule and ω > 1 criterion; the full correction family and exact extraction remain unstated. Do not propagate the aBSREL edition to MEME/BUSTED-MH. Foreground branch, gene-wide and site-level hypotheses and their cohorts differ. HyPhy MEME is an evolutionary model, not the motif-discovery program.

review.use_summary: Reused the SCENIC+ ensemble motif resource: its authors had clustered 49,504 PWMs from 29 sources into 8,045 clusters using Tomtom distances. The paper then scanned DMRs with Cluster-Buster in SCENIC+.
review.implementation_scope_note: This describes provenance of precomputed motif clusters, not a new Tomtom run in the paper. Edition, clustering linkage, distance and significance settings are unstated. Cluster-Buster occurrence scanning and TF-gene cluster annotations are separate capabilities.

review.use_summary: Reused SCENIC+ motif clusters created by the SCENIC+ authors from 49,504 PWMs and 29 sources, producing 8,045 clusters based on Tomtom distances. Scanned DMRs separately with Cluster-Buster.
review.implementation_scope_note: Do not count the resource-construction statement as a new Tomtom execution. The edition, comparison settings and clustering construction remain unstated. Motif occurrence, TF annotation and downstream enrichment require their own inputs and methods.

review.use_summary: Matched TF-Modisco patterns to similar TF-binding motifs with Tomtom using the cisTarget motif collection.
review.implementation_scope_note: The RRID identifies the tool, not its software edition. Distance, pseudocount/background, overlap/strand and significance/correction settings are unstated. TF-Modisco discovery and the cisTarget resource are separate from motif comparison.

review.use_summary: Matched TF-Modisco-derived PWMs to the linked motif-clustering database with tomtom -dist kullback -motif-pseudo 0.1 -text -min-overlap 1. The upstream patterns were trimmed at flanking information content below 0.4.
review.implementation_scope_note: The Tomtom edition, exact database release, background, strand choice, output significance cutoff and correction family are unstated. The information-content trimming is upstream processing, not a Tomtom option; do not infer its logarithm units or treat the closest match as evidence of occupancy.

review.use_summary: Annotated MEME-discovered motifs from differentially accessible promoter/intergenic ATAC peaks by comparing them to known JASPAR motifs with Tomtom.
review.implementation_scope_note: Edition, JASPAR release and complete comparison parameters are unstated. The captured author ATAC scripts do not supply a Tomtom command. Motif discovery, genomic region annotation and actual TF binding are separate claims.

review.use_summary: Computed motif similarities with Tomtom using stated default settings, visualized them by hierarchical clustering, and summarized similar pairs passing q < 0.1 as fractions of possible motif pairs within TF classes.
review.implementation_scope_note: The edition is unstated, so defaults are not converted into a fixed command. Preserve the original query/target and q-value families and class-pair denominator; direction, self-pair and multiplicity conventions are not specified. ggseqlogo and clustering are separate steps.

review.use_summary: Aligned EU-seq reads to mm10 with BWA-MEME 1.0.4 and soft clipping of supplementary alignments. Subsequently filtered mapping quality below 10 with SAMtools, removed rRNA/tRNA overlaps with BEDTools and counted gene-body reads with HTSeq.
review.implementation_scope_note: The spelling bwa meme is supported by the cited BWA-MEME publication, not an ordinary BWA 0.7.x run. The exact alignment command, model/index provenance and read parameters are unstated; no specific clipping flag is invented. Existing BWA integration does not supply BWA-MEME, and the downstream filtering/counting/DESeq2 normalization remains separate.

review.use_summary: Detected H3-associated k-mers in intronic MUC5AC VNTR sequences with STREME from MEME Suite 5.5.4.
review.implementation_scope_note: The STREME width, alphabet/background, positive/control construction, objective, hold-out and significance settings are unstated.
